description: This file defines the Login component for a gym management web application. It handles user login via email/password and Google Sign-In using Google Identity Services. The component manages form state, initializes Google Sign-In SDK, handles credential responses, and redirects upon successful login.

methods.name: Login()
methods.description: React functional component for user login, managing form inputs, Google Sign-In setup, and navigation after login.

methods.name: handleGoogleCredential
methods.description: Handles the response from Google Sign-In, exchanges credential for tokens, updates auth tokens, and navigates to the protected route.

methods.name: setupGis
methods.description: Initializes Google Identity Services SDK, renders the Google Sign-In button, and prompts One Tap sign-in.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for email/password login, performs sign-in via the auth context, and redirects.
